facts.holding-pentacle: A young person lifts a pentacle in both hands and gazes at it quietly.
facts.red-hood: The young person wears a red hooded cap with a long cloth hanging from it, and green clothes.
facts.meadow: The young person stands in a meadow of blooming flowers.
facts.plowed-field: A plowed field can be seen far off on the right.
facts.trees-mountain: There is a grove of trees on the left and a mountain on the right, and the sky is yellow.

glosses.plowed-field: Land to cultivate ahead; a plan to grow in reality.
glosses.meadow: A possibility just beginning to sprout.

reversedGloss.blocked: There is a plan, but carrying it out is late.
reversedGloss.waning: The wish to learn and the focus drop.
